title: v1 consumer always uses rebalanceCallback; wait-for-background-tasks flag removed
answers: why does rebalanceCallback run for v1 consumer
rebalance_cb true vs callback in consumer-v1
body:
consumer-v1.ts passes `rebalance_cb: this.rebalanceCallback.bind(this)` unconditionally. The flag CONSUMER_WAIT_FOR_BACKGROUND_TASKS_ON_REBALANCE (config.ts, KafkaConsumerConfig, ingestion KafkaConsumerBaseConfig) no longer exists.
With `rebalance_cb: true`, node-rdkafka handles assign/unassign itself, so rebalanceCallback, the assignment metric (kafkaConsumerAssignment) and the revoke hook never fire. Do not reintroduce a mode that bypasses rebalanceCallback.
The consume loop skips consuming while rebalanceCoordination.isRebalancing, so every code path that sets it must also reset it (resetRebalanceCoordination).
The v2 consumer never used the flag.
says: Kafka v1 consumer background tasks configuration flag removed
v1 consumer no longer supports background task wait option
Rebalance callback always active in v1 consumer now
v1 consumer rebalance behavior changed with deprecated flag
search: When configuring the v1 Kafka consumer (nodejs/src/common/kafka/consumer/consumer-v1.ts), it unconditionally passes rebalanceCallback via rebalance_cb; the CONSUMER_WAIT_FOR_BACKGROUND_TASKS_ON_REBALANCE flag was removed from CommonConfig and KafkaConsumerBaseConfig. Every code path that sets rebalanceCoordination.isRebalancing must call resetRebalanceCoordination to clear the pause, because the consume loop skips consumption while isRebalancing. Do not reintroduce any mode that bypasses rebalanceCallback, even though with rebalance_cb: true, node-rdkafka handles assign/unassign internally and the callback and kafkaConsumerAssignment metrics never fire.
